title: Selected-component zoom positioning verified
summary: The 2x zoom control now centers the selected image region horizontally and vertically, instead of opening at the top-left.

changes.detail: Center zoom on the active selected region, including the specific camera/screw/cable instance clicked. Clamp to image edges.
Selecting another piece from the picker while zoomed recenters it. Resize and image-load events retain selected focus. Zoom out resets both scroll axes.
Localized zoom labels now distinguish Zoom selected from Show full phone.

validation.name: Phone and history regressions
validation.detail: 10 tests passed. In all three languages, geometry checks verify both-axis storage centering, camera recentering via picker, edge clamping, targeting the second camera instance and resetting both axes on zoom out.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused lint
validation.detail: App typecheck and photo-view ESLint passed.

validation.name: History integrity
validation.detail: 203 preceding reports valid before this follow-up.

validation.name: Live browser/device
validation.detail: Scroll geometry tested with simulated viewport dimensions; physical-device appearance and touch panning not visually verified. No deployment or APK rebuild.
